idea: Algebraic flag voltages (Singer index / PG(1,q) parameter / discrete logs) with random matchings are far worse than random; random flags give VALID m=14 at q=13 (seed 4)
next: Keep random flags (algebraic potentials kill cycle diversity); make the matchings structured and non-incident, and anneal the m=14 q=13 design to m=15-16 with NSRC sampling.

idea: C = <S>, S in Sp(4,q) of projective order (q^2+1)/2 (semiregular on points and lines); C-invariant flag voltages, C-equivariant matchings with orbit-level voltages, orbit-level annealing
next: Anneal q=13 m=32 from the VALID m=28 design (add sheets) and try the order-17 and order-5 subgroups of C (more orbit parameters) with longer runs.

idea: plain baselift annealing (MOVES vvvM, T0=2 T1=0.1) with warm starts: identity remap Z_m->Z_m+1 then anneal; sampled annealing plus bisection repair of uncovered sources at q=13
next: repair loop for q=13 m=15 (bisect bad sources with badsrc.py, anneal on bad+random sample, full check); longer q=7 warm starts at m=18

idea: flag-only lifts: matchings M1, M2 sheet-preserving (voltage 0), all voltage on the GQ flags; random flag voltages reach VALID m=14 at q=13, annealing gives VALID m=16 at q=7
next: rescan failing sources (scan.sh) and anneal in rounds on failing sources plus a sample, then full eval, for q=13 m=15-16; m=15 random has 6 uncovered, m=16 has 24

idea: Z_5 x Z_k level skeleton: flags level 0, matching 1 level 1, matching 2 level 2, random sheet parts, anneal sheet parts only (FIXMOD=5); sheet parts on flags (variant B) far better than flags zero (A).
next: Skeleton is weaker than unstructured lifts (q=13 k=2 stalls at 5334 uncovered; unstructured is valid at m=12): try longer anneals at q=7 k=3 and q=11 k>=2 (not run), or let the level be annealed on flags.

idea: Min-conflicts repair: pick an uncovered (source, target, sheet), shift one edge voltage on a random non-backtracking base walk (length <= 6) by the sheet miss so the walk reaches it; Metropolis on the uncovered count (800 bad + random sources, full check every 100 steps)
next: q=13 m=24 from random is about 4x slower than m=23 (370 uncovered at 187 s vs 86); try best-of-K candidates (K=4), longer runs or warm continuations, and q=11 (not run with this tool yet)

idea: Rainbow: 1-factorization of I + M1,M2 (q+3 colours); spec voltage CRT(level, f(c)) with f 2-to-1 onto Z_k\0 is about 10x worse (q=13 m=45: 4.26M uncovered; FIXMOD=5 anneal stalls ~4.8k at m=20); injective rainbow (distinct voltages in Z_m, no levels) + free anneal gives VALID at q=7 m=16 and m=18.
next: Drop the Z_5 level-0 flag skeleton (it doubles uncovered counts): free residues per colour; at q=13 anneal the injective m=17-18 start with full-source moves (m=18: 72 -> 64 uncovered in 240 s, too slow), try m=20 at q=7 with 2 seeds.

idea: Level skeletons (L,t1,t2): flags 0 mod L, matchings t1,t2 mod L, sheets annealed with FIXMOD=L; scan L and k
next: Level quotient (k=1) is a necessary condition, so L=9,11,12 are dead for these t values; try relaxing the flag level to free and anneal k=1 matchings for L=9,11,12 longer.
